name: pixkit
description: 纯前端在线图片工具站：压缩、证件照、格式转换、改尺寸

scripts.deploy: npm run dist && npx wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:dry: npm run dist && npx wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir=.wrangler/dry
scripts.test: node tests/build.mjs && node tests/e2e-compress.mjs && node tests/e2e-idphoto.mjs && node tests/e2e-devtools.mjs && node tests/e2e-texttools.mjs && node tests/e2e-i18n.mjs && node tests/e2e-i18n-runtime.mjs && node tests/e2e-pwa.mjs && node tests/e2e-drop.mjs
